steps.surface: New session form → model picked → memory warning
steps.path: Round 4 of P-18: two short lines and the app's toggle
steps.headline: Unfolded, the warning shows one line of numbers and a 'Warn me about this model' toggle row — nothing else.
steps.changed: The paragraph is gone. Why? now shows '9.5 GB model + 15.6 GB for 128k context, with 8.9 GB already loaded.' and a toggle row, 'Warn me about this model — Off skips this next time.', all inside the strip. The bare checkbox is replaced by the same toggle row every other on/off setting uses.
steps.notice: Two lines to read and one switch, in the shape you already know from Settings.
steps.risk: The numbers line is the whole explanation; the longer reasoning lives in the model's fit label and Settings instead.
